title: How should Emergency Sell All run: in the HTTP request one position after another (today), or as a bounded background job, and should it pause buying first?

options.name: Keep current behaviour: serial, unbounded, inside the request; no pause; no idempotency
options.risk: One stuck position delays or blocks the rest with no progress shown; a second click runs a second loop; failures are reported as "lock held"; the bot keeps buying during and after the emergency (AUD-API-004, AUD-API-015).

options.name: Set the global pause first, then run the sell-all as a single background job with an id (a second request returns the running job), a wall-clock budget per position and per-position progress and reasons
options.behavior_impact: Pressing Emergency Sell All also stops new snipes until the operator resumes; the dashboard shows progress and the true outcome of every position.
options.risk: The operator must remember to resume; the job runner is new code on the money path.

options.name: Background job with idempotency, budgets and progress as above, but buying continues (add a separate Pause button)
options.behavior_impact: Emergency sell no longer stalls silently; entries continue unless the operator pauses.
options.risk: New positions bought during the emergency stay open unless paused separately.

options.name: Only set the global pause before the existing loop (and add a Pause button); keep the in-request loop
options.behavior_impact: Stops new entries during an emergency; the loop behaves as today.
options.risk: Leaves the unbounded, non-idempotent, misreported loop (AUD-API-004).

recommendation: Pick together with EXIT-07 (which reason and speed operator sells use) and the RC-10/RC-11 fixes; a job that pauses first matches what the dialog promises the operator.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); no S1 rests on this card alone (the stall cause is RC-10/RC-11).
behavior_impact: Decides how the dashboard panic button sells, what it reports, and whether it stops new buys.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof), together with EXIT-07
